content: Babiloone kawoy Nabukadanaxoori di77idi, ba biitta efida asaape guye, Yerusalaamenne Yihuda banta katamaa katamaa simmida asay haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysata.
Enta halaqati Zarubaabela, Iyyasu, Nahime, Saraya, Ra7ila, Mardikiyoosa, Bilisaana, Masefaara, Baguwaya, Rehuumanne Ba7ana. Di7ope simmida asaa tayboy haysa.
Iyyasunne Yo7aaba koche gidida Fahat-Moo7abe yaray 2,812;
Di7ope simmida kahineta soo asaa tayboy haysa. Iyyasu koche gidida Yadaya yaray 973;
Di7ope simmida Leeweta tayboy haysa; Hodawa koche gidida Iyyasunne Qadimeela yaray 74;
Xoossa keetha penge naagiya Salooma, Axeera, Xalmoona, Aquba, Haxixanne Sobaya yaray 139.
Haysati di7ope simmidi, Xoossa keethan oothiya asaa yarata; Xiha yara, Hasufa yara, Xaba7oota yara,
Keraasa yara, Siha yara, Fadoona yara,
Libana yara, Agaba yara, Aquba yara,
Agaba yara, Samila yara, Hanana yara,
Gadalla yara, Gahaara yara, Raya yara,
Ra7asoona yara, Naqooda yara, Gasaama yara,
Oza yara, Faseeha yara, Besaya yara,
Asina yara, Me7unima yara, Nifuseesima yara,
Baqibuuqa yara, Haqufa yara, Harhura yara,
Basiluuta yara, Mahida yara, Harsa yara,
Barqoosa yara, Sisaara yara, Teema yara,
Haysati di7ope simmida Solomone oosanchota yarata; Soxaya yara, Sofeereta yara, Faruuda yara,
Ya7ila yara, Darqoona yara, Gadalla yara,
Safaaxa yara, Haxeela yara, Fakiraata yara, Haxaboyma yaranne Ama yara.
Di7ope simmidi, Xoossa keethan oothiya asa yaratinne Solomone aylleta yarata tayboy 392.
Haysafe kaalleysati qassi Talmela, Telaresa, Karuba, Adaananne Imera katamatape Yerusalaame simmidosona. Shin enti woyko enta aawati Isra7eele sheeshi gideysa erisanaw enti danda7ibookona.
Kahinetape Abaya yaray, Aqoosa yaraynne Barzile yaray simmidosona. Barziley ha sunthan xeegetanaw danda7iday Galada biitta asi gidida Barzile na7iw macho ekida gishosa.
Haysati banta yeleta xaphuwa eranaw yeleta maxaafan koydosona, shin demmibookona. Hessa gisho, enti tuna geetetidi kahinetethan oothonna mela digetidosona.
Uriimeninne Tumiimen shaakidi pirdiya kahiney dendana gakanaw, enti geeshsha kathaafe maanaw danda7onaysa Ayhudeta ayseysi entaw odis.
Di7ope Yihuda simmida asaa tayboy kumethi 42,360.
Hessika 7,337 addenne macca aylleta gujunna de7ishina. Enta giddon 200 addenne macca zammaareti de7oosona.
Enti Yerusalaamen de7iya Xoossa keetha gakida wode issi issi soo asaa halaqati Xoossa keethay kase ba bessan keexetana mela banta dosan imota immidosona.
Issoy issoy baw danda7ida mela Xoossa keetha oosuwas imota immis; imotay 500 kilo giraame worqa, 2,800 kilo giraame biranne 100 kahineta ma7o immidosona.

Hessafe guye, kahineti, Leewetinne guutha asay Yerusalaamen uttidosona; zammaareti, Xoossa keetha penge naageysatinne Xoossa keethan oothiya oosanchoti Yerusalaame yuushon de7iya katamatan uttidosona; attida asa ubbay banta katamatan katamatan uttidosona.
